rules.D1: Detection: full marks within 3 s of the first radar paint, zero at 20 s.
rules.C1: Identification: correct = 18 + 12 × confidence; wrong = 10 × (1 − confidence), +5 if friend/foe was right.
rules.R2: Bird or clutter → hold; don't waste an effector.
rules.R4: No radio link, GNSS-guided → GNSS spoof or interceptor.
rules.R5: Engage the most urgent threat first.
rules.R6: Gun in an urban area → collateral risk.
rules.R7: Engage with at least 8 s to impact.
rules.R8: A hostile must not reach the asset or observe unchallenged.
rules.R9: Unknown civil drone: report and monitor; do not engage.
rules.R10: After a miss, engage again before impact.
